method: Visible unchanged Windows Coding GUI: 5 formats × 2 requested resolutions × 3 crop/frame offsets. Frame on/off, code then case change, 100% reset on I01–I29 clamped to native minimum. Actual screenshots measured with color marker landmarks; nine native masked/unmasked probe pairs per case. Synthetic files.
observations: PNG/JPEG/BMP/TIFF preserve physical dimensions through metadata; GIF has no DPI field and uses 96 DPI.
Animated GIF and multipage TIFF show the first frame/page.
The crop option shifts the frame; the source bitmap remains intact.
The native minimum zoom is fit-to-window, which can exceed 100% and even 200% for small images.
comparison: Compare native probe membership to actual rendered browser mask, stored pixels and first-frame colors, physical image/template sizes and case change. Screen RGB values are color-managed; no font or screenshot byte-equality claim.
limits: This 30-case product covers image/frame display and case changes. Previously captured scan/template gestures remain separate evidence; every possible gesture sequence is not implied.
E00 preliminary focus/capture attempts excluded; only final named screenshots packaged.
